info.title: CryptoDeck
info.author: DanilKhmyrov
info.description: Live crypto prices on your Switch
info.details:
CryptoDeck turns a Nintendo Switch on a stand into a crypto price display.

It shows a grid of 23 coins by default, 16 per screen, each card tinted by its 24-hour direction so the grid answers "what's up, what's down" before you read a number. Sort by 24-hour change or keep your own order, and open any coin for a chart from 1 hour to 7 days with the high and low marked.

A coin pulses when it moves more than its own 24-hour range would suggest, so the alert threshold is per coin rather than one number for everything.

Add any Binance pair by ticker; icons are downloaded and cached to the SD card. Prices in USD, EUR or RUB at a real daily exchange rate. Pairs Binance has stopped trading are detected and reported instead of showing a frozen price.

The screen never dims or blanks — burn-in is handled by slow drift instead. Light and dark themes, true black in dark mode.

Written in TypeScript on nx.js.
